questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. United Nations maintains peace and security in the world.

B. It also takes care of developing friendly relations between nations.

C. United Nations also strives to implement the principles of equality.

D. It also acts as a centre through which countries coordinate their actions and activities for global peace.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option (2)** i.e. **'ABCD'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct sequence after rearrangement is **A-B-C-D.**__
 
• **Sentence 1** is first as it introduces the United Nations and its primary objective of maintaining world peace.
 
• **Sentence 2** follows naturally as it expands on this, detailing how peace is fostered via inter-nation friendship.
 
• **Sentence 3** transitions from inter-nation relationships to discuss principles that the UN promotes (i.e., equality), further expanding on the organization's objectives.
 
• **Sentence 4 **concludes by linking back to the UN's broader role, as introduced in Sentence 1, and details that the UN acts as a coordinating center for the nation's actions and activities for peace.

__Therefore, the complete paragraph after rearrangement is:__*** United Nations maintains peace and security in the world. It also takes care of developing friendly relations between nations. United Nations also strives to implement the principles of equality. It also acts as a centre through which countries coordinate their actions and activities for global peace. ***

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

It is said that this is the oldest temple in the region.

options.text: This is said to be the oldest temple in the region.
This is told to be the oldest temple.
This temple is said in the region to be.
This oldest temple is said to be in the region.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1).** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Present Indefinite Tense.
 
• The rule for changing a Present Indefinite Tense from Passive voice to Active voice.
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the passive sentence becomes the subject of the active sentence.
 
• 'It' is the subject and "this is the oldest temple in the region." is the object.
 
• Here in this sentence the part **"It is said that this is" **will be changed into **"This is said to be"**. "**This**" is the subject.
 
• Use of the expression "to be": In the active voice, the verb "is" is used in combination with the infinitive "to be" to express the state or attribute of the subject.

Therefore, the correct answer is ***This is said to be the oldest temple in the region.*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Remember, both of these sentences are in passive voice, it's just two different ways to express the information passively. Typical passive-to-active voice conversion changes the subject-object relationship: e.g., "The mouse (subject) was chased by the cat (object)" vs. "The cat (subject) chased the mouse (now the object)".

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word ‘Conventional’.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1)** i.e. **'Customary'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Conventional (परंपरागत)** - Based on or in accordance with what is generally done or believed.

 
 
• **Example:** His methods, though conventional, are very effective.
 
 
 
• **Customary (प्रथासिद्ध) **- According to the customs or usual practices associated with a particular society, place, or set of circumstances.
 
 
• **Example:** It is customary to greet each other with a handshake.
 
 
 
• From the above example it is clear that '**Customary**' is the synonym of '**Conventional**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is * 'Customary'.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Contemporary (समकालीन)** - Living or occurring at the same time.

 
 
• **Example:** The gallery showcases the work of contemporary artists.
 
 
 
• **Unusual (असामान्य)** - Not habitually or commonly occurring or done.
 
 
• **Example:** Seeing snow in this region is unusual.
 
 
 
• **Abnormal (असाधारण)** - Deviating from what is normal or usual.
 
 
• **Example: **The doctor said that there was an abnormal increase in the patient's heartbeat.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘vengeance’.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3)** i.e. **'Forgiveness'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vengeance (प्रतिशोध)** - Punishment inflicted in retaliation for an injury or offense.

 
 
• **Example:** He sought vengeance for his brother's murder.
 
 
 
• **Forgiveness (क्षमा)** - The action of forgiving or being forgiven for an error or offence.
 
 
• **Example: **He asked for forgiveness for his thoughtless actions.
 
 
 
• From the above example it is clear that '**Forgiveness**' is the antonym of '**Vengeance**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is ***'Forgiveness'.*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Example: **Handing out red envelopes during the Chinese New Year is a popular custom.
 
 
 
• **Requital (बदला)** - Something given in return, compensation, or retaliation.
 
 
• **Example: **He promised a swift requital for the insult.
